name: Long March 12 (CZ-12, CALT)

cd.note: aero only: LM-3B family fitted Cd transferred, see fixed_params; ASSUMPTION

glow_kg.note: 433 t (huijiwiki: ~430 t); used as a CHECK only (sim GLOW reported in mass_budget)

propellant_kg.derived: = burned: 4-engine mdot 1689.2 kg/s (4 x 1250 kN / (301.84 s x g0)) x 196.315 s; no load published

dry_kg.derived: prop x (1/0.92 - 1): structure coefficient 0.92 ASSUMED (same as Kinetica-2 config; LM-12 stage masses unpublished); YF-100K dry 1820 kg each (huijiwiki) is inside this

thrust_sl_N.note: YF-100K sea-level 1250 kN x4 = 5000 kN liftoff thrust (also W); throttling unmodelled (full thrust ASSUMED)

thrust_vac_N.derived: 4 x (1250 kN + P0 x Ae), Ae = pi x (1.373 m / 2)^2 = 1.4806 m^2 from published nozzle exit diameter 1.373 m (huijiwiki YF-100K); = 1400.0 kN per engine

isp_vac_s.derived: SL Isp 301.84 s (huijiwiki YF-100K) x Fvac/Fsl, so mdot = F/(Isp g0) is unchanged from the published SL pair

cutoff_s.note: '一级发动机关机 196.315 s', Y7 typical flight sequence (Hainan Commercial SF-18 mission handbook via huijiwiki), TYPICAL not this flight's

separation_s.note: S1/S2 separation 198.315 s, same typical sequence

propellant_kg.derived: = burned: mdot 107.50 kg/s (2 x 180 kN / (341.5 s x g0)) x (622.505 - 200.315) s = 45384 kg first burn + 1935 kg for the published 18 s restart (1622.505-1640.505 s); no load published

dry_kg.derived: prop x (1/0.92 - 1), same structure-coefficient ASSUMPTION as S1

thrust_vac_N.note: 2x YF-115B, 180 kN each (huijiwiki); Wikipedia lists base YF-115 176.5 kN vac

isp_vac_s.note: base YF-115 vacuum Isp; YF-115B value unpublished, base value ASSUMED

cutoff_s.note: '二级发动机一次关机 622.505 s', typical sequence

mass_kg.assumption: not published; 5.2 m diameter fairing (huijiwiki), mass ASSUMED

vertical_rise_s.assumption: not published for LM-12; 15 s = LM-2C published programme-turn time (https://sat.huijiwiki.com/wiki/长征二号丙), borrowed (as Kinetica-2)

cd.derived: FITTED LM-3B value transferred (aero only); filled at run time from vehicles/lm3b.json fitted_family; ASSUMPTION

kick_deg.basis: ASSUMPTION bound; liftoff T/W ~1.18 (5000 kN / 433 t) needs a small kick (larger kicks crash in probes)

payload_kg.basis: upper bound LEO capability 12 t (W); 9 SatNet sats (LL2), mass not published

header_notes: LM-12: thrust/Isp from huijiwiki (YF-100K SL pair, YF-115B thrust) + Wikipedia (YF-115 Isp, GLOW); stage masses DERIVED from published burn times with an ASSUMED 0.92 structure coefficient; event times = CALT TYPICAL Y7 sequence (huijiwiki), not this flight's.
